description_en: Queries scaling configurations of the ECI type
description_zh: 查询ECI类型的伸缩配置信息
kebab_example: aliyun ess describe-eci-scaling-configurations --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --page-number 1 --page-size 50 --scaling-group-id asg-bp17pelvl720x3v70000 --scaling-configuration-id asc-bp17pelvl720x5ub0000 --scaling-configuration-name scalingcon0000 --api-version 2014-08-28 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeEciScalingConfigurations

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the scaling group to which the scaling configuration belongs
parameters.help_zh: 伸缩配置所属伸缩组的地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The page number of the scaling configuration list. Minimum value: 1.

Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh:
伸缩配置列表的页码，起始值：1。

默认值：1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page for a paged query. Maximum value: 50.

Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh:
分页查询时设置的每页行数，最大值：50。

默认值：10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The ID of the scaling group. You can query all scaling configurations in the specified scaling group
parameters.help_zh: 伸缩组的ID，您可以查询该伸缩组下所有的伸缩配置
parameters.name: scaling_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The IDs of the scaling configurations that you want to query. You can specify 1 to 10 IDs.

The query results include scaling configurations in both the Active and Inactive states, which are identified by the LifecycleState response parameter
parameters.help_zh:
待查询伸缩配置的ID列表，ID数量取值范围：1～10。

查询结果包括生效和未生效的伸缩配置，并通过返回参数LifecycleState进行标识
parameters.name: scaling_configuration_id

parameters.help_en:
The names of the scaling configurations that you want to query. You can specify 1 to 10 names.

Invalid scaling configuration names are ignored in the query results, and no error is returned
parameters.help_zh:
待查询伸缩配置的名称列表，名称数量的取值范围：1～10。

查询结果会忽略失效的伸缩配置名称，并且不报错
parameters.name: scaling_configuration_name
